title: 第7章 各方势力第8章 他是神仙么
slug: 我修天道见谁都能一招秒
content_zh:
剑玄宗，主峰。
“惠南师兄，不好了！”
一位灰衣中年人，慌慌张张的冲进了主峰大厅。
剑玄宗宗主惠南，缓缓睁开双眼，看着来人眉头微皱。
“韩峰师弟，多大的人了，还是这么毛毛躁躁，发生什么事了？”
他慢条斯理问道。
韩峰脸色阴沉，道：“师兄，蓝家传信，说明辛师弟，死在边北城罗家！”
“什么？”
这一下，惠南的脸色也变了。
“详细说来！”
惠南急切道。
“蓝秀儿传信说，她让明辛去罗家退婚，可是那罗家霸道蛮不讲理，一听说退婚，不仅直接拒绝，还偷袭出手，杀了明辛师弟，废了兰秀儿修为！”
“并且，罗家少主罗天还扬言，三个月后，要上我剑玄宗，斩尽我宗门弟子，灭我宗门道统！”
韩峰说道。
惠南眼中寒芒闪烁，最终收敛起来。
“此女所言，怕是不实，估计是想故意挑拨我们出手，替她铲除后患。”
惠南说道。
韩峰一愣，挠了挠头道：“还是师兄睿智，我倒是没有想到此节。
那若是如此的话，我们不管了？”
惠南眼中精芒一闪，道：“不管？怎么可能？就算她所言不实，但明辛师弟之死总假不了，这个仇一定要报！”

韩峰当即道：“没错，该为师弟报仇！
那我现在下山，去灭了罗家？”
惠南看了一眼韩峰，眼神之中充满了失望之色。
“韩峰，你什么时候能动动脑子？明辛师弟，可是御空境五重修为，实力与你不相伯仲！
他都死了，你再去不也是送死？”
韩峰想了想，点点头道：“好像是哦，那我再去找几位御空境的同门一起去？”
惠南摇摇头道：“不行，对手的实力都没有摸清楚，现在贸然出手，对我们不利！
更何况，现在宗门上下都在忙那件事，也抽不出几个御空境的人来了。”
韩峰道：“这也不行，那也不行，那您说怎么办？”
惠南目光一瞥，落在了旁边的一块刻着神武二字的令牌上。
“我记得那个蓝秀儿，似乎被神武王世子看中了吧？”
惠南道。
韩峰点点头道：“好像是有这么回事。”
惠南哼道：“那这件事，就交给神武王府处理吧，我们替他们卖命，他们总得替我们办点事才行。”
韩峰两眼一亮，竖起大拇指道：“师兄，高！”
另一边，夜风国都，神武王府。
“啊……舒坦！”
content_en:
Jianxuanzong, the main peak.
"Senior Brother Huinan, it's not good!"
A middle-aged man in gray clothes rushed into the main peak hall in a panic.
Huinan, the leader of Jianxuan Sect, slowly opened his eyes and frowned slightly as he looked at the visitor.
"Junior Brother Han Feng, how old are you, but you are still so frizzy? What happened?"
he asked slowly.
Han Feng's face was gloomy and he said: "Senior Brother, the Lan family has sent a letter stating that Junior Brother Xin died in the Luo Family of Bianbei City!"
"What?"
This time, Huinan's expression also changed.
"Tell me the details!"
Huinan said anxiously.
"Lan Xiu'er sent a message saying that she asked Ming Xin to go to the Luo family to cancel the engagement, but the Luo family was overbearing and unreasonable. When they heard about the cancellation, they not only refused directly, but also made a sneak attack, killing junior brother Ming Xin and ruining Lan Xiu'er's cultivation!"
"Moreover, the young master of the Luo family, Luo Tian, has threatened that in three months, he will come to my Sword Xuan Sect, kill all my disciples, and destroy our sect's orthodoxy!"
Han Feng said.
Huinan's eyes flickered with coldness and finally calmed down.
"I'm afraid what this woman said is untrue. She probably wants to deliberately provoke us to take action to eliminate future troubles for her."
Huinan said.
Han Feng was stunned, scratched his head and said: "Senior brother is still wise, I didn't expect this.
If that's the case, then we don't care? "
Huinan's eyes flashed, and he said: "No matter what? How is it possible? Even if what she said is untrue, the death of Junior Brother Mingxin cannot be faked, and this revenge must be avenged!"
Han Feng immediately said: "Yes, it's time to avenge junior brother!
Then I go down the mountain now and destroy the Luo family? "
Huinan glanced at Han Feng, his eyes full of disappointment.
"Han Feng, when are you going to use your brain? Junior Brother Mingxin is at the fifth level of the Sky Control Realm, and his strength is on par with yours!
He's already dead. If you go, won't you be sending yourself to death? "
Han Feng thought for a while, nodded and said, "It seems so. Then I'll go find a few fellow students from the Sky Control Realm to go with me?"
Huinan shook his head and said: "No, our opponent's strength is not clear yet, so taking action rashly now will not be good for us!
What's more, now that everyone in the sect is busy with that matter, they can't spare a few people from the Sky Control Realm. "
Han Feng said: "This won't work, that won't work either, so what do you think we should do?"
Huinan glanced at a token next to him with the word "Shenwu" engraved on it.
"I remember that Lan Xiu'er seems to have been favored by Prince Shenwu, right?"
Huinan Road.
Han Feng nodded and said, "That seems to be the case."
Huinan hummed: "Then let this matter be left to Prince Shenwu's Mansion. We work hard for them, and they have to do something for us."
Han Feng's eyes lit up, he gave a thumbs up and said: "Brother, high!"
On the other side, the capital of Night Wind Kingdom, the palace of Prince Shenwu.
"Ah... comfortable!"
